changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.comment: Fill operator and value_to of every condition, of current and old versions
changeSet.sql: UPDATE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition SET operator = CASE WHEN value_type IN ('ARRAY', 'STRING') THEN 'IN' ELSE 'GT' END

UPDATE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition uw SET operator = 'RANGE', value_to = rej.value FROM stop_factors.stop_factor_condition rej WHERE uw.result = 'UNDERWRITER' AND rej.result = 'REJECTED' AND rej.stop_factor_id = uw.stop_factor_id AND CASE WHEN uw.value_type IN ('INTEGER', 'DOUBLE') AND rej.value_type IN ('INTEGER', 'DOUBLE') THEN rej.value::numeric > uw.value::numeric ELSE false END

rollback.sql: UPDATE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition SET operator = NULL, value_to = NULL

changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.comment: operator is required, value_to only for RANGE
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition ALTER COLUMN operator SET NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_operator CHECK ( CASE WHEN value_type IN ('ARRAY', 'STRING') THEN operator = 'IN' ELSE operator IN ('GT', 'RANGE') END), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_value_to CHECK ( CASE WHEN operator = 'RANGE' THEN result = 'UNDERWRITER' AND value_to IS NOT NULL AND value_to::numeric > value::numeric ELSE value_to IS NULL END)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition DROP CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_value_to, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_operator, ALTER COLUMN operator DROP NOT NULL

changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition DROP CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_value_to, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_operator, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_operator CHECK ( CASE WHEN value_type IN ('ARRAY', 'STRING') THEN operator = 'IN' ELSE operator IN ('GT', 'GTE', 'LT', 'LTE', 'EQ', 'RANGE', 'BETWEEN') END), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_stop_factor_condition_value_to CHECK ( CASE WHEN operator IN ('RANGE', 'BETWEEN') THEN value_to IS NOT NULL AND value_to::numeric > value::numeric ELSE value_to IS NULL END)
